scientific_integrity: Exact finite polynomial coefficient certificate, independently reproducible from the displayed formulas and standard-library Python checker. No independent audit or general-n proof has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only n=4 or n=5 and categorical alphabet size at most n.

Possible classical unindexed equivalent transformation remains a literature risk.
title: Exact uniform-occupancy mixtures for four- and five-draw categorical richness
